cs.t: I use poker 2 with blue switches and code keyboard with green switches. Amazing experience. Love it.
cs.th: Ask HN: Should I get a mechanical keyboard?

cs.t: I know I'm in the minority here, but I always bring a small mechanical keyboard anywhere I go. Usually something quiet, in case I'm working in a coffee shop or something. A Poker2/3 fits well over the MBP's keyboard without hitting any of the keys on accident.
